summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography excerpt on American singer, dancer, and actress Britney Spears. It covers her birth and childhood, her signing with Jive Records in 1997, and her early album successes. It also notes her 2001 self-titled album, her starring role in the film Crossroads, and her creative control of the album In the Zone.
one_line: Biographical overview of American singer and actress Britney Spears, from her childhood and 1997 Jive Records signing through her early chart-topping albums.
key_facts: Britney Jean Spears was born on December 2, 1981.
Britney Spears is an American singer, dancer, and actress.
Spears was born in McComb, Mississippi, and raised in Kentwood, Louisiana.
As a child, Spears performed acting roles in stage productions and television shows.
Spears signed with Jive Records in 1997.
Her first and second studio albums, ...Baby One More Time (1999) and Oops!... I Did It Again (2000), became international successes.
...Baby One More Time was the best-selling album by a teenage solo artist.
The title tracks '...Baby One More Time' and 'Oops!... I Did It Again' broke international sales records.
In 2001, Spears released her self-titled third studio album, Britney.
Spears played the starring role in the film Crossroads (2002).
Spears assumed creative control of her fourth studio album, In the Zone (2003).
The single 'Toxic' from In the Zone achieved worldwide success.
